An adult craft kit for crocheting your own fawn from chunky yarn. A relaxed hobby project for quiet evenings, and a handmade gift idea for someone who likes making things.

  • Crochet craft kit – a DIY make-it-yourself project in a chunky-yarn style
  • Navy blue – the kit shown in navy
  • Acrylic – the supplier lists the fabric as acrylic
  • One kit per order – supplied in a single bag

Good to know: this is an adult craft kit, not a toy. The supplier does not give an age recommendation, a finished size, or a full list of what is in the bag, so please check the product photos before you order.

Shipping

Tracked shipping across Canada and the USA, calculated by weight at checkout. Estimated delivery is 13–25 days to Canada and 10–20 days to the US from the day you order. See our Shipping Policy for details.

A pen holder shaped like a book, with a retro look for your desk, shelf or study corner. It holds pens and pencils and doubles as a small decorative piece.

  • Density board material – listed as density board

Good to know: one pen holder per order. Colours and finish may vary slightly between screens and between pieces.

A lightweight folding seat cushion for bleachers, benches and outdoor seating. It folds up to carry and is made from Oxford cloth. One cushion per order, for one person.

  • Oxford cloth – listed by the supplier as an Oxford fabric cushion
  • Folds to carry – portable for games, picnics and the park
  • Three colours – black, red or blue

Good to know: the supplier gives no filling, waterproofing or load details, so we do not make those claims. Sizes are approximate.

A women's knitted hat, scarf and gloves set with a diamond pattern, sold together as one three-piece set in the colour you choose.

A lightweight pet carrier bag for puppies, kittens and other small pets, with breathable mesh. Carry it as a backpack or handbag. Available in two sizes and three colours.

  • Oxford cloth body
  • Breathable nylon mesh
  • Pockets – room inside the pockets for a cup, garbage bags or keys
  • Medium-firm structure – the supplier lists the bag hardness as medium to hard
  • Two sizes, three colours – S or L in grey, pink or blue

Size

Size Length × Height × Width (cm) Inches
S 39 × 17 × 27 cm 15.4 × 6.7 × 10.6 in
L 44 × 17 × 29 cm 17.3 × 6.7 × 11.4 in

A large outdoor mat for picnics, beach days and camping. It lays out to about 260 × 205 cm, with room for 2 to 4 people, and comes with accessories in the pack.

This geometric-print shower curtain is made from water-resistant PEVA and hangs from a reinforced grommet top.

  • Wide pattern range — dozens of colors and prints, from botanicals to simple checks and solids.
  • 9 size combinations — widths from 80cm to 240cm with a 180cm or 200cm drop, for standard and custom shower openings.
  • Grommet top — fits any standard curtain rod.

Wipe clean and hang dry.

A simple, modern shower curtain in waterproof PEVA, with a reinforced grommet top that fits a standard curtain rod. Choose from eight solid colours or three subtle prints.

  • Reinforced grommet top — fits a standard curtain rod
  • 9 sizes — widths from 31.5″ (80 cm) to 94.5″ (240 cm), with a 70.9″ or 78.7″ drop
  • Wipe clean — no laundering needed; wipe down and hang dry

Which size? Standard tub alcove: 70.9″ × 70.9″. For a walk-in or corner shower, measure the rod and add 12″ for gather.

A calm, Nordic-inspired refresh for your bathroom. Thickened polyester in a soft terrazzo print — neutral enough to disappear into a minimalist room, textured enough to stop it feeling bare.

Which size? A standard Canadian bathtub alcove takes 70.9″ × 70.9″ (180 × 180 cm). Measure your rod end to end and add 12″ so the curtain gathers properly instead of hanging flat.

Pick a runner a little longer than your table so the ends drape over. The 140 cm length suits coffee tables and small tables; 220–260 cm suits full-size dining tables.
